notesStmt.note: This manuscript probably dates to the first weeks of April 1888, shortly before the poem's publication in the Herald. Whitman was, at this time, under contract to the newspaper for ten pieces every month (see With Walt Whitman in Camden [Boston: Small, Maynard & Company, 1906] 1:41–42).
"Life" was first published in the New York Herald on April 15, 1888. November Boughs.

lg.head: Life.
lg.l: The Ever the undiscouraged resolute soul of man;

Ever the grappled mystery—ever the same
in all known earth's ages old or new,

Ever the eager eyes, hurrahs, the welcome clapping
hands, and the loud applause;

Ever the busy busy curious brain struggling to
solve the problem.
